spec_match.rationale: Implements the explainer's use case 2 verbatim: a choice-question schema over palette commands, the three-step availability/create/decide workflow, confidence-thresholded action, and destroy() in a finally block.

interactive.rationale: Free-text goal input plus a route button that attempts the real workflow; probability bars and winner highlighting render only from genuine model output.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises real calls, honest absence, and a labelled look at the brittle workaround; the page delivers each.

edge_cases.rationale: Branches for unavailable devices, download-monitor progress, drifted result shapes (reported raw, not coerced), absence (verbatim ReferenceError), and the keyword matcher's zero-overlap failure — explicitly labelled as NOT API output.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5155080092385280 and the explainer use case; notes the WebMCP composition as out of scope with the reason.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite pins the surface this page calls (create/decide/destroy, availability enum); honest 0/6 on 141 matches the page's absence branch.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP driver: route attempt threw ReferenceError displayed verbatim, workaround panel reported zero keyword overlap for the canonical phrasing, schema JSON rendered, console clean, 0px overflow desktop and mobile (mobile screenshot read). Partial: no provider exists in this container, so the decide()/probability-bar path is unexercised and pinned by the result-shape guards.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts cover decided, unavailable, absent, and shape-drift branches distinctly; the absent branch never reports as success.

design_system.rationale: Tokens only; winner card inverts background AND text colour together; the amber workaround panel keeps charcoal text on paper (AA).

accessibility.rationale: Labelled text input with described hint, native button, probability bars carry role=img with percentage labels while values are also in text, single polite output narrates each attempt.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Harness ok/ok; command cards and pre-wrapped status text fit 360px with no horizontal overflow.

openQuestions.title: Capture a real decide() run with probabilities
openQuestions.detail: With the WebAI extension polyfill or a flag-enabled Chromium build, run the canonical 'let my coworkers view this file' route and verify the probability bars, winner highlight, confidence threshold text, and the 0.85 act/suggest split against real output.

guidanceConsulted.query: built-in AI session workflow availability create monitor decide destroy untrusted output
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Gate create() on availability(), surface downloadprogress, destroy sessions when done, and never innerHTML model output.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Workflow follows that exact order with a monitor updating the live status, destroy() in finally, and all model-derived strings rendered via textContent.

guidanceConsulted.query: announcing async decision results and progress to screen readers
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: One polite live region; meaningful final announcements; progress only when informative.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Status output is the single polite region; download progress replaces (not stacks) its text; probabilities are text alongside the visual bars.

summary: Explainer use case 2 as a runnable router: real availability/create/decide/destroy workflow, calibrated-probability rendering reserved for genuine output, and the keyword-matcher workaround shown failing and labelled as the pre-API baseline. Verified with the repo headless-Chromium-141 CDP driver (no chrome-devtools-mcp here): honest ReferenceError branch, clean console, ok/ok responsive matrix.
